text: Care to join me, Goodfellow? Oh, ice-boy. A moonlight stroll with you? Do you even have to ask?
author: Julie Kagawa

text: Together, we form a necessary paradox; not a senseless contradiction.
author: Criss Jami

text: I did not always think he was right nor did he always think I was right but we were each the person the other trusted.
author: Joan Didion

text: Happy is the man who finds a true friend, and far happier is he who finds that true friend in his wife.
author: Franz Schubert

text: A successful marriage requires falling in love many times, always with the same person.
author: Mignon McLaughlin

text: It is not a lack of love, but a lack of friendship that makes unhappy marriages.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: I love being married. It's so great to find that one special person you want to annoy for the rest of your life.
author: Rita Rudner

text: Marriage may be the closest thing to Heaven or Hell any of us will know on this earth.
author: Edwin Louis Cole

text: Love is moral even without legal marriage, but marriage is immoral without love.
author: Ellen Key

text: If I get married, I want to be very married.
author: Audrey Hepburn

text: A happy marriage is a long conversation which always seems too short.
author: Andre Maurois

text: Marriage is the highest state of friendship. If happy, it lessens our cares by dividing them, at the same time that it doubles our pleasures by mutual participation.
author: Samuel Richardson

text: Marriage is a great institution.
author: Elizabeth Taylor

text: My husband and I are best of friends first and foremost. We fight like cats and dogs, but never stay mad for long. I was lucky to find him, he is in every way, my soulmate.
author: Carnie Wilson

text: If you want to read about love and marriage, you've got to buy two separate books.
author: Alan King

text: A journey is like marriage. The certain way to be wrong is to think you control it.
author: John Steinbeck

text: My most brilliant achievement was my ability to be able to persuade my wife to marry me.
author: Winston Churchill

text: To keep your marriage brimming, With love in the loving cup, Whenever you're wrong, admit it; Whenever you're right, shut up.
author: Ogden Nash

text: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: Don't marry the person you think you can live with; marry only the individual you think you can't live without.
author: James Dobson

text: Marriage is an attempt to solve problems together which you didn't even have when you were on your own.
author: Eddie Cantor

text: There is nothing nobler or more admirable than when two people who see eye to eye keep house as man and wife, confounding their enemies and delighting their friends.
author: Homer

text: When you make the sacrifice in marriage, you're sacrificing not to each other but to unity in a relationship.
author: Joseph Campbell

text: Marriage is not about age; it's about finding the right person.
author: Sophia Bush

text: Marriage has made me a lot happier and I'm deeply in love with my wife, and I thank God for her every day.
author: Harry Connick, Jr.

text: Experts on romance say for a happy marriage there has to be more than passionate love. For a lasting union, they insist, there must be a genuine liking for each other. Which, in my book, is a good definition for friendship.
author: Marilyn Monroe

text: Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.
author: Aristotle

text: Marriage is like watching the color of leaves in the fall; ever changing and more stunningly beautiful with each passing day.
author: Fawn Weaver

text: Being in a long marriage is a little bit like that nice cup of coffee every morning – I might have it every day, but I still enjoy it.
author: Stephen Gaines

text: Marriage is a risk; I think it's a great and glorious risk, as long as you embark on the adventure in the same spirit.
author: Cate Blanchett

text: Marriage is a mosaic you build with your spouse. Millions of tiny moments that create your love story.
author: Jennifer Smith

text: There is no more lovely, friendly, and charming relationship, communion, or company than a good marriage.
author: Martin Luther

text: A good marriage is where each partner secretly suspects they got the better deal.
author: Unknown

text: The highest happiness on earth is marriage.
author: William Lyon Phelps

text: Marriage, ultimately, is the practice of becoming passionate friends.
author: Harville Hendrix

text: For it was not into my ear you whispered, but into my heart. It was not my lips you kissed, but my soul.
author: Unknown

text: Happy marriages begin when we marry the ones we love and they blossom when we love the ones we marry.
author: Tom Mullin

text: Love doesn't make the world go round. Love is what makes the ride worthwhile.
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

text: Love is like a friendship caught on fire.
author: Jeremy Taylor

text: The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
author: Audrey Hepburn

text: There's always that one special person that no matter what they do to you, you just can't let them go.
author: Mignon McLaughlin

text: The greatest thing you'll ever learn is just to love and be loved in return.
author: Moulin Rouge

text: Death cannot stop true love. All it can do is delay it for a while.
author: The Princess Bride

text: You have bewitched me, body and soul, and I love you. I never wish to be parted from you from this day on.
author: Pride and Prejudice

text: Marriage is getting to have a sleepover with your best friend every night of the week.
author: Christie Cook

text: Marriages are like fingerprints; each one is different, and each one is beautiful.
author: Maggie Reyes

text: A great marriage is not when the 'perfect couple' comes together. It is when an imperfect couple learns to enjoy their differences.
author: Dave Meurer

text: To be fully seen by somebody, then, and be loved anyhow--this is a human offering that can border on miraculous.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

text: The greatest marriages are built on teamwork, a mutual respect, a healthy dose of admiration, and a never-ending portion of love and grace.
author: Fawn Weaver

text: Don't let doubt convince you that your marriage is not worth fighting for.
author: Jennifer Smith

text: Marriage is meant to keep people together, not just when things are good, but particularly when they are not. That's why we take marriage vows, not wishes.
author: Ngina Otiende

text: Chains do not hold a marriage together. It is threads—hundreds of tiny threads which sew people together through the years.
author: Simone Signoret

text: What counts in making a happy marriage is not so much how compatible you are, but how you deal with incompatibility.
author: Leo Tolstoy

text: The goal in marriage is not to think alike, but to think together.
author: Robert C. Dodd

text: You come to love not by finding the right person, but by seeing an imperfect person perfectly.
author: Sam Keen

text: Ultimately, the bond of all companionship, whether in marriage or in friendship, is conversation.
author: Oscar Wilde

text: More marriages might survive if the partners realize that sometimes, the better comes after the worse.
author: Doug Larson

text: Where there is love there is life.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

text: There is only one happiness in this life, to love and be loved.
author: George Sand

text: The greatest happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved.
author: Victor Hugo

text: You are my today and all of my tomorrows.
author: Leo Christopher

text: I look at you and see the rest of my life in front of my eyes.
author: Unknown

text: When I saw you I fell in love, and you smiled because you knew.
author: Arrigo Boito

text: I love you, not only for what you are, but for what I am when I am with you.
author: Roy Croft

text: In your smile, I see something more beautiful than the stars.
author: Beth Revis

text: I saw that you were perfect, and so I loved you. Then I saw that you were not perfect and I loved you even more.
author: Angelita Lim

text: When I look at you, I can feel it. I look at you and I'm home.
author: Finding Nemo

text: I am at rest with you. I have come home.
author: Dorothy L. Sayers

text: You are my heart, my life, my one and only thought.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle

text: I would rather share one lifetime with you than face all the ages of this world alone.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

text: To love and be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
author: David Viscott

text: To me, you are perfect.
author: Love Actually

text: It was a million tiny little things that, when you added them all up, meant we were supposed to be together.
author: Sleepless in Seattle

text: You complete me.
author: Jerry Maguire

text: I like you very much. Just as you are.
author: Bridget Jones's Diary

text: It would be a privilege to have my heart broken by you.
author: The Fault in Our Stars

text: I'm also just a girl, standing in front of a boy, asking him to love her.
author: Notting Hill

text: You make me want to be a better man.
author: As Good As It Gets

text: You should be kissed and often, and by someone who knows how.
author: Gone With the Wind

text: So this is love, so this is what makes life divine.
author: Cinderella

text: To face the future with another, who means more than any other, is to be loved.
author: The Rescuers

text: You mean more to me than anyone in this whole wide world.
author: Peter Pan

text: My dream wouldn't be complete without you in it.
author: The Princess and the Frog

text: You're the best thing I never knew I needed.
author: The Princess and the Frog

text: If there ever comes a day when we can't be together, keep me in your heart. I'll stay there forever.
author: Winnie the Pooh

text: You are my greatest adventure.
author: The Incredibles

text: We loved with a love that was more than love.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

text: I am yours, don't give myself back to me.
author: Rumi

text: If I loved you less, I might be able to talk about it more.
author: Jane Austen

text: I do love nothing in the world so well as you: is not that strange?
author: William Shakespeare

text: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep; the more I give to thee, the more I have, for both are infinite.
author: William Shakespeare

text: Love looks not with the eyes, but with the mind, and therefore is winged Cupid painted blind.
author: William Shakespeare

text: I would not wish any companion in the world but you.
author: William Shakespeare

text: Hear my soul speak: The very instant that I saw you, did my heart fly to your service.
author: William Shakespeare

text: So long as men can breathe or eyes can see, so long lives this, and this gives life to thee.
author: William Shakespeare

text: The heart's not like a box that gets filled up. It expands in size the more you love.
author: Her

text: A University degree, four books, and hundreds of articles and I still make mistakes when reading. You wrote me 'good morning' and I read it as 'I love you'.
author: Mahmoud Darwish

text: Someone loves everything you hate about you.
author: Frank Ocean

text: You are my favorite hello.
author: Unknown

text: Together is my favorite place to be.
author: Unknown

text: Love is a verb, not just a word.
author: Unknown

text: You feel like home to me.
author: Unknown

text: Us against the world.
author: Unknown

text: I choose you. Every single day.
author: Unknown

text: Love harder than yesterday.
author: Unknown

text: You are my calm in the chaos.
author: Unknown

text: Still falling for you.
author: Unknown

text: Together, we have it all.
author: Unknown

text: You are my person.
author: Unknown

text: The best is yet to come for us.
author: Unknown

text: Grow old with me.
author: Unknown

text: Your hand fits perfectly in mine.
author: Unknown

text: Real love is quiet and steady.
author: Unknown

text: I loved you then. I love you still.
author: Unknown

text: With you, I am home.
author: Unknown

text: Love isn't perfect. It's worth it.
author: Unknown

text: My heart is wherever you are.
author: Unknown

text: Forever looks good on us.
author: Unknown

text: We've loved each other so long I've never been a man and not loved her.
author: Sarah Perry

text: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
author: Emily Brontë

text: Now, I'm not going to deny that I was aware of your beauty. But the point is, this has nothing to do with your beauty. As I got to know you, I began to realise that beauty was the least of your qualities.
author: Choderlos de Laclos

text: Love starts as a feeling, but to continue is a choice. And I find myself choosing you, more and more every day.
author: Justin Wetch

text: A man bought twenty flowers, nineteen real and one fake. He said: I will love you until the last flower dies.
author: Unknown

text: The highest form of love is consideration: when someone thinks about how things would make you feel, pays attention to detail, and holds you in regard when making decisions that could affect you. In any bond, how much they care about you can be found in how much they consider you.
author: Kira J

text: I love you, most ardently.
author: Jane Austen

text: If you were the sun, I would continue to stare at you, even if it cost me my vision, for I would know the last thing I saw was perfection.
author: Unknown

text: If a million loved you, I am one of them. If one loved you, it was me. If no one loved you, then know that I am dead.
author: Franz Kafka

text: I don't love you with my heart and mind. I love you with my soul, in case my mind forgets and my heart stops.
author: Unknown

text: If everything around me is my imagination, then you're the best thing I've come up with.
author: Unknown
